title: Speedometer Layout Market: Dashboard Layouts Made by Drivers
description: Browse the dashboard layouts Speedometer Live Wallpaper players built and shared: speed, trip, weather and music widgets, drawn live in any of 19 styles.

social.title: The Speedometer layout market
social.description: Dashboard layouts made and shared by Speedometer Live Wallpaper players, each drawn by the app itself. Try one in your browser, then use it on your phone.
social.imageAlt: Speedometer Live Wallpaper: a phone on a car's dashboard at night, showing the Amber Night gauges at 87 km/h, with rain and city lights on the windscreen

@graph.name: The Speedometer layout market
@graph.description: Dashboard layouts that Speedometer Live Wallpaper players built in the app's layout builder and shared. Every layout works with every one of the app's 19 styles.

art.alt: Four phones on a showroom counter in front of a sports car, each showing a different Speedometer dashboard

sections.title: The layout market
sections.intro: Speedometer players build their own dashboards in the app, from the speed and the trip to the weather and the song that's playing, and share them here. Every layout works with every style. Search by name or by a layout's code.

sections.title: How the market works
sections.intro: Browsing and using layouts is free. Each picture here is the layout drawn by the app's own engine, in the style its maker used; open a layout to see it live in any style or to try it in your browser.

items.title: Use one
items.text: Open Styles, then Layout market in the app, find the layout by name or code, and tap Use. It goes on your wallpaper in the style you have.

items.title: Rate it
items.text: After using a layout, rate it from one to five stars in the app. Top rated lists the layouts with at least 10 ratings.

items.title: Share your own
items.text: Build a layout in the app and publish it with a free VHub account: up to 5 a day and 30 in the market at once.

items.title: Report a problem
items.text: A rude name, a copy or a layout that doesn't work: report it on its page here or in the app, and we look at it.
